content: उपवस् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To dwell in or at, inhabit (with <ab>acc.</ab>); तपःश्रद्धे ये ह्युपवसन्त्यरण्ये <ls>Muṇḍ. 1. 2. 11</ls>. वैकुण्ठम् उपवसति <ls>Sk.</ls> .²2 To be in a state of abstinence, abstain from food, fast; उपवसेद्दिनम् <ls>Ms. 2. 220</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 20</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 292</ls>, <ls n="Y. 3.">64</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab> also); उपोषिताभ्यामिव नेत्राभ्यां पिबन्ती <ls>Dk. 4</ls>. .²3 To go to (a master). .²4 To enter upon, learn, take to, begin. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to fast.
